Messages.Author: Lambach
Messages.Body:
1. When exactlydo you yield contested cards? When does the not-yielded
one "reappear"?

2. If I play "Disguised weapon" to equip with Ivory Bow after my
opponent declared a strike with his own Ivory Bow, When are the Bows
contested? Does my opponent get a strike?

Thanks
LR

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Lambach wrote:
>
> 1. When exactlydo you yield contested cards? When does the not-yielded
> one "reappear"?

During your untap.
During the controller's untap.

> 2. If I play "Disguised weapon" to equip with Ivory Bow after my
> opponent declared a strike with his own Ivory Bow, When are the Bows
> contested? Does my opponent get a strike?

As answered on 3/19/98: The bows contest immediately. Your opponent's
strike fizzles, just as if his weapon had been destroyed with First
Strike.
